We have an mfpm executable. First package manager to be launched in 2016

As always edits and testing welcome.

To use this program paste it somewhere executable. Add a line to /etc/mfpm.list including this link https://voat.co/v/mfpm/comments/753303

That is a repository index. Now run the program once without arguments to build your database and acquire updates.

./mfpm

Now run it with a package.

./mfpm gcc

You can also supply a target directly after gcc to instruct the kind of build.

What is still needed... We need a way to clean the cache. For now there is

rm ~/.mfpm/cache/* -r

We also need a reddit driver. For now only Voat urls are supported. Voat comes first and I will makes sure the reddit community knows it.

Dependencies:

wget, bash, make, jshon
